headline: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash leaps 10 spots to 11th as four newcomers crash the bottom of the board
summary: DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash still sits on top with 24.3% of tokens, and DeepSeek as a provider holds 35.7%. The day's loudest move belongs to Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash, which climbed from 21st to 11th, while Anthropic, xAI, Perplexity, and Google's gemini-2.5-flash-lite made their first appearances near the bottom of the list.
highlights: Xiaomi's mimo-v2.6-flash jumped 10 places to 11th, the biggest one-day climb on the board, with a 2.2% token share.
DeepSeek and Tencent together account for 47.5% of tokens, the top two providers in the cumulative share ranking.
New entrants: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 (43rd), x-ai/grok-4.7 (45th), perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.2 (50th), and google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite (51st).
Dropouts: qwen3-embedding-8b, mistral-nemo, tencent/hy4-preview, and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl all fell off the ranked list.
Qwen's qwen3.8-flash rose 5 places today and 20 over seven days, now sitting 26th.
